info.name: Aarsi Apparel – Full order flow (existing + proposed)
info.description: Existing endpoints plus proposed order-flow endpoints with full payloads. Run 15 first; its test script stores orderId / orderNumber / trackingToken for the later requests. See API_SPEC.md.

request.description: Shipping, GST, COD and returns config. Storefront uses it for the ticker, trust strip, free-shipping progress and FAQ copy.

originalRequest.description: Shipping, GST, COD and returns config. Storefront uses it for the ticker, trust strip, free-shipping progress and FAQ copy.

request.description: Active categories (`parentId`, `imageUrl`, `productCount`).
Active storefront collections (used for hero slides, mega menu and collection banners).

Paginated cards: `{items,total,page,pageSize,totalPages}`. Filters: `search, category, collection, fabric, size, color, minPricePaisa, maxPricePaisa, featured, newArrival, bestSeller, trending`.

**Requested additions (the storefront currently emulates these client-side over the first 200 matches):** `sort=price_asc|price_desc`, `onSale=true`.
Full product with variants. **Please confirm field names against the example** — the storefront reads several aliases, but this is the shape it is designed for.

response.name: Example

request.description: [NEW – proposed] Re-prices server-side, **reserves stock**, creates the order and, for `online`, a Razorpay order. `quoteTotalPaisa` is the total the customer saw; if the server total differs → `409 PRICE_CHANGED`. Send `Idempotency-Key` (UUID) — retries with the same key return the same order.
